name: Belly of the Beast
body:
School conjuration (teleportation); Level magus 5, occultist 5, psychic 5, sorcerer/wizard 5, summoner 4, witch 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S, M (a remorhaz scale)

EFFECT

Range touch

Target creature touched

Duration instantaneous

Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

You instantly teleport the creature touched inside the belly of another creature you can see as if the creature swallowed the target whole. The target may be of any size and always arrives in the exact spot desired, but the creature you teleport the subject into must have the swallow whole special attack and be large enough to accommodate a creature of the target’s size. If the creature does not satisfy the preceding requirements, the spell fails. Only the target receives a Will save to negate this spell. However, if you attempt to teleport the target into a creature with spell resistance, you must overcome that creature’s spell resistance to teleport the target into the creature, otherwise the spell fails.
